evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies genesis block verification and block-index building during reindex in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an unhandled corruption state during reindex where a corrupted genesis block body causes an assertion failure or leaves the node hanging in RPC warmup indefinitely. As noted in the PR description, 'With -checkblockindex, the default on regtest, it aborts on an assert in CheckBlockIndex. Without it, it stays in RPC warmup.' While improving corruption handling and crash safety, an invalid genesis block on disk is a narrow edge case that can be safely deferred.
